pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to positions (averaging down/falling knife pyramiding) until price confirms a structural higher-low on the 5-minute timeframe with volume expansion.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: No order execution permitted unless ATR(14) volatility expansion is below the 80th percentile and order flow imbalance confirms momentum direction.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$10.00 and hard trail the remainder to lock in minimum +$15.00 gains.
